name: Playwright test agents
author: Microsoft

amendments.append: This binds every agent that writes or repairs tests, including test-generation and 'healer' agents: none adds `skip` / `fixme` / `fail` / `todo`, switches to `networkidle` waits or fixed sleeps, or rewrites expectations to match current output; when it can't make a test pass honestly it stops and reports — quarantine (TEST-5) is a human decision.

notes: The healer agent is told 'Do not ask user questions' and to mark an unfixable test test.fixme() — the opposite of AGT-8; its generator guidance (role-based locators, no networkidle) agrees with the standard.
rationale: Cited for the AGT-8 extension because it is the clearest real instance of the failure: its healer agent is told not to ask and to mark unfixable tests test.fixme(). Its generator guidance (role locators, no networkidle) is preferred over Anthropic's webapp-testing, which recommends networkidle waits.
